examples.en: I think we're being very short-sighted in not exploiting our own coal.
examples.zh: 我想我们不开采利用自己的煤矿实在是目光短浅。

examples.en: There are a lot of jokes about people who are too fat or physically handicapped, deaf, or short-sighted things like that.
examples.zh: 有很多关于肥胖者、残疾人（如聋人、近视者）的笑话。

examples.en: Only a short-sighted man will lose sight of the importance of education.
examples.zh: 只有鼠目寸光的人才会看不见教育的重要性。
